Dana, I cannot release the hold without alignment from Credit. 

Priya placed C-2207 (Pellham Industrial) on hold earlier this morning due to 3 invoices totaling $41,600.00 that are over 60 days overdue. Because your request conflicts with Priya's instruction, I have notified you both so you can coordinate on the account status.
